rationale.conceptual: The real-space winding number involves building the Q matrix from eigenstates, applying chiral symmetry, commuting with the coordinate operator, and tracing the central block—an established but multi-part algorithm that needs careful translation from the paper’s equations. It is not a trivial textbook operation nor a wholly novel method.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two identical script invocations (bounded and unbounded cases) with different parameters, using only NumPy. No multi-stage orchestration, external tooling, or data assembly is required; straightforward CSV output.
